items.text: haan ji
thoda wait karna
nahi mila address

items.context: Can you please wait for a moment
items.text: thoda ruk jaiye

items.context: Are you there with the delivery person now
items.text: ji haan

items.context: Okay so the address is not clear right
items.text: accha samajh gaya
delivery wala call nahi utha raha hai abhi tak
mera toh address samajh nahi aa raha hai shayad
woh banda location dhundh nahi pa raha hai
maine contact kiya par woh phone switch off hai
aapko kuch aur instructions chahiye ya main batata hun
kabhi kabhi block number se call karte hain delivery wale
matlab wo thoda late ho raha hai shayad is wajah se call nahi kar raha

items.context: Have you tried speaking to the delivery person directly
items.text: mujhe phone par baat karne ko keh rahe the

items.context: What did the delivery person say about the delay
items.text: haan usne kaha woh raste mein thoda phas gaya hai

items.context: Did you ask for the exact location from them
items.text: maine bola ki exact location bhejo mujhe

items.context: Are they able to find your address with the location you gave
items.text: woh location pe bhi nahi mil raha hai driver

items.context: Is there any mistake in the address you provided
items.text: main responsible bhi hoon kyunki maine sahi address nahi diya
delivery wala baar baar call kar raha tha par main phone utha nahi paya tha kuch der ke liye
maine driver ko location ke baare mein phir se bata diya hai fir bhi woh dhoondh nahi pa raha hai
thoda rukein please main unse baat karta hoon takki delivery jaldi final ho jaye

items.context: What is the delivery person's update on reaching your address
items.text: haan usne kaha woh aapke building ke pass aa gaya hai lekin entry mil nahi rahi mujhe

items.context: Can you please wait a little longer for the delivery
items.text: aap se request hai ki thoda aur sabr dikhayen kyunki driver ko traffic ki wajah se problem ho rahi hai

items.context: Are you sure the driver is at the correct address
items.text: main confirm kar raha hoon ki woh galat jagah par toh nahi ruk gaya hai aap thoda wait karein

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: agent_unreachable - the delivery person is not answering or cannot find the address
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
